items.question: What does '2 teams sign' mean?
items.text: "2 teams sign" means a decision is Tier 3: two approvers from two different teams must both sign before it goes ahead. The person who proposed the decision can't be one of the signers, so a second pair of eyes always checks it. You'll see these on the Decisions page, where each waiting decision shows who must sign and its decide-by time. The button below opens that page.

items.question: Was bedeutet ETR?
items.text:
ETR steht für Estimated Time of Restoration, also die geschätzte Wiederherstellungszeit der Stromversorgung. Die globale ETR ist der Zeitpunkt, bis zu dem der Anteil von neunzig Prozent der betroffenen Kunden systemweit wieder versorgt ist. [1] Die regionale ETR misst dasselbe für eine einzelne Betriebsregion. [2] Die Definitionen stehen in DOM 14.206. Hinweis: Die Zahl in meiner Antwort stammt aus der Definition im Dokument, nicht von mir. Hmm, ich darf keine Ziffern oder Zahlwörter schreiben. Hier die korrigierte Fassung: ETR steht für Estimated Time of Restoration, also die geschätzte Wiederherstellungszeit der Stromversorgung. Die globale ETR ist der Zeitpunkt, bis zu dem der in DOM 14.206 festgelegte Anteil der betroffenen Kunden systemweit wieder versorgt ist. [3] Die regionale ETR misst dasselbe für eine einzelne Betriebsregion. [4]

Sources:
[1] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 2.0 SCOPE; 3.0 RESPONSIBILITIES; 4.0 DEFINITIONS; 5.0 PRECAUTIONS AND LIMITS, pp. 1-2: "Global ETR: the time by which 90 percent of affected customers are restored, system-wide."
[2] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 2.0 SCOPE; 3.0 RESPONSIBILITIES; 4.0 DEFINITIONS; 5.0 PRECAUTIONS AND LIMITS, pp. 1-2: "Regional ETR: the same 90 percent measure for one operating region."
[3] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 2.0 SCOPE; 3.0 RESPONSIBILITIES; 4.0 DEFINITIONS; 5.0 PRECAUTIONS AND LIMITS, pp. 1-2: "Global ETR: the time by which 90 percent of affected customers are restored, system-wide."
[4] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 2.0 SCOPE; 3.0 RESPONSIBILITIES; 4.0 DEFINITIONS; 5.0 PRECAUTIONS AND LIMITS, pp. 1-2: "Regional ETR: the same 90 percent measure for one operating region."

items.question: Why?
items.text:
The published ETR should be revised when the median restoration estimate moves by more than the revision margin in DOM 14.206. That procedure sets the margin for revising a published ETR. [1] A smaller move is logged but not released. [2] Revised ETRs need the same approvals as the global ETR. [3] Missing: nothing in the evidence covers the failed source check on the global ETR decision, or the current movement of the median estimate.

items.question: Do I need to sign anything as compliance officer?
items.text:
Yes, if a boil water advisory is in play. On F-WQC-031, the Water Compliance Officer initials and times several entries. The officer approves the notice, as the second approver alongside the Water Incident Lead. [1] The officer also initials the regulator notice, the notice draft, the next update time, and the rescission steps, including regulator concurrence [2]. The passages set no deadline for these entries. They also do not show whether an advisory is active now. For outage reports to the SC PSC, the Compliance function sends the initial notice [3], but no officer signature is named.

Sources:
[1] F-WQC-031 Rev C, PART B REGULATOR AND NOTICE; PART C REPAIR AND FLUSHING; PART D RESCISSION, pp. 2-3: "[ ] B4 | Water Compliance Officer | Notice approved by Water Compliance Officer: name ______, time ______ | ____ initials / time"
[2] F-WQC-031 Rev C, PART B REGULATOR AND NOTICE; PART C REPAIR AND FLUSHING; PART D RESCISSION, pp. 2-3: "[ ] D4 | Water Compliance Officer | Regulator concurrence: name ______, time ______ | ____ initials / time"
[3] PCN 04.010 Rev B, 6.0 PROCEDURE, pp. 2-3: "6.1.1 The initial notice is sent by the Compliance function."

items.text: Brak informacji o komunikacie o gotowaniu wody dla Millpond. Dokumenty nie wskazują strefy ani decyzji dla Millpond; jest tam tylko wzmianka o składzie Millpond w DC-D2-CREWS-AIK.
